in_marathi.name: Chandrapal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrapal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrapal is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: Chandra (moon) and Pal (protector). It is believed to be a name of the moon god, Indra or Chandra, who protects his devotees. The name is widely used in Hindu culture.
